faq1Q: How do I add PREM to my server?
faq1A: Click the "Add the bot" button at the top, select your server in Discord, and grant the required administrator permissions.
faq2A: Yes, it is free for any basic community! If you want a better experience, we also offer a Premium plan packed with exclusive options.
faq3Q: How does the levels and XP system work?
faq3A: Users earn XP automatically by chatting and participating. You can enable or configure leveling from the Dashboard.
faq4Q: How can I play music in my voice channel?
faq4A: Join a Discord voice channel and use /play followed by the song name or link so PREM starts high-fidelity playback.
faq5Q: How do I get money or virtual coins?
faq5A: Claim daily rewards with /daily, work with /work, or take a risk with /crime.
faq6Q: Where can I rate the bot or leave a review?
faq6A: Use the interactive /review command in any Discord chat to rate PREM with stars and post your opinion on the website.
